_what: What the one sharing tool (do-work/share-anything.mjs) keeps and says. A share is one workspace record at record_prefix + <label> in the sharer's own account: { reach: [{ type, id? | prefix? }], title, about?, can: ["view"], people: [{ principal, key_blake3, added_at }], published, revoked_at, expires_at, changed_at }. Each person, AI or link it is shared with gets its own key: token_prefix + 32 random bytes (base64url); only the BLAKE3 hex of that key is kept. The engine (trillion-rust src/account_rights/share-grant.json door_grant) reads exactly the reach of a record that names the presenter's digest now, so record_prefix and token_prefix here are the engine's, read from there when they change.

run._what: A share that lets its people run some of the sharer's Workshop tools at the sharer's own door, with no copy on their computer (can: ["run"]): kept by the engine's run grant (trillion-rust src/account_rights/share-grant.json `act`) in the sharer's vault through keep_operation and read back through list_operation, at the run's own door resource, for the one label `grant` names. The grant is {tools, identity, journal}; people are {principal, key_blake3}. How long it lasts is the person's choice and by default it has no end (the owner, Nov 17 2026): the rule they give is kept as `ends` beside the grant ({until?, unused_days?, since}), which the engine keeps and never reads, and the sweep (do-work/end-shares-whose-condition-failed.mjs, run by a wake the person switched on) lists every run share with its rule and last use and withdraws one whose rule says it has ended, with withdraw_operation. check_every_ms is how often that wake runs: the engine writes a share's last use at most once an hour (share-grant.json act.use_every_seconds, 3600), so judging more often reads nothing new. identity and journal are the defaults a share that names neither gets.

words.op: op is share, stop, access or end.
words.grant: grant is where this share is kept: {grant}.
words.thing: thing is one of: { type, id }, { list: <list id> }, { text, title? } or { items: [{ type, id? | prefix? }], title }.
words.can: A share lets people view it (can: ["view"]) or run the tools it names at your door (can: ["run"], with tools).
words.tools: A share that runs tools names 1 to {most} tool ids (tool:...), each once.
words.run_principal: A person or AI a share runs tools for is named by 1 to 128 letters, digits, _ or -.
words.run_link: A share that runs tools is given to named people or AIs, each with a key of its own, never a link.
words.run_choice: identity is none or self, and journal is input or none.
words.different_tools: {label} already shares other tools. Stop it first to share these.
words.added_runner: {principal} can now run {tools} at your door, with no copy on their computer, until you stop it or its end rule says.
words.until: until must be a future time (ISO), or left out or null for no end.
words.unused_days: unused_days must be a whole number of days, 1 or more, or left out or null for no such end.
words.end_run_only: Only a share that runs tools (can: ["run"]) takes an end rule here; a shared view takes until.
words.origin: origin must be a web address starting https://.
words.principal: A person or AI is named by 1 to {most} characters with no control characters; the name {link} is the link's.
words.who: Name who to share with, or ask for a link.
words.already: This is already shared with {principal}. Stop sharing with them first to give them a new key.
words.kept_failed: The share could not be kept after {tried} tries: another change to it kept getting in. Try again.
words.too_many: A share holds at most {most} people.
words.added_person: Shared {title} with {principal}. They can only view it, until you stop it.
words.added_link: Made a link to {title}. Anyone with it can only view it, until you stop it.
words.ends_unused: It ends after {days} days with no use.
words.no_end: It has no end: it stands until you stop it.
words.swept: Ended {ended} shares whose end rule said so; {waiting} have a rule whose end has not come, and {never} have no end.
words.sweep_nothing: No share's end rule says it has ended; {waiting} have a rule whose end has not come, and {never} have no end.
words.unjudged: {count} shares have no last use the engine answers, so only their until is read.
